reason: The proposed action attempts to remove items from a pending order by calling modify_pending_order_items with empty new_item_ids. Policy permits modifying items only to different variants of the same product (e.g., changing size/color), not removing items entirely. The policy states: 'For a pending order, you can take actions to modify its shipping address, payment method, or product item options, but nothing else' and 'each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.' Removing three office items while keeping hiking items is outside this scope. Additionally, this exact call previously failed with 'The number of items to be exchanged should match,' indicating the tool validates that new_item_ids must pair with item_ids for modifications, not removals.
policy_references: For a pending order, you can take actions to modify its shipping address, payment method, or product item options, but nothing else.
For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option. There cannot be any change of product types.
Exchange or modify order tools can only be called once per order.
